summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with six Next Day Disclosure Returns covering September 13-16, 2026, disclosing on-market share repurchases on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under Main Board Rule 13.25A. The September 11, 2026 disclosure shows 107,040 ordinary shares repurchased for cancellation at an average price of USD 2.2708 per share, representing 0.0088% of existing issued shares, with total issued shares remaining at 1,214,041,449. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The repurchases require cancellation and compliance with insider dealing and share buyback rules; watch for continued buyback cadence, cancellation execution, and potential shareholder return expansion.
